lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 005: address reviewer finding

openQuestions: check:all has pre-existing failures in lint (runPostMerge cognitive complexity in post-merge.ts) and file-size (src/supervisor/events.ts:344>290, src/ui/SetupScreen.tsx:290>254, test/vendor/cam-ship-hygiene.test.ts:91>50, src/commands/setup.ts:697>650). These were failing before US-R1-005 and are not introduced by this story.
nextStoryContext: US-R1-005 was a documentation-only fix. The ci-gated bullet in cam-ship.md incorrectly claimed that runPostMerge 'closes issue, prints summary'. The code (src/release/post-merge.ts) does only: checkout main, pull origin main, create/push tag, delete branch locally/remotely. The fix: (1) removes 'close issue, print summary' from the description; (2) states that github/linear backends must close the issue manually after merge (gh issue close); (3) clarifies that the none backend was already closed in Step 5 (--finalize); (4) changes 'Skip Steps 8-9' to 'Skip Step 9' since Step 8 only applies to github/linear anyway. Both templates/commands/cam-ship.md and .claude/commands/cam-ship.md were patched identically; bun run embed-vendor was run to sync src/vendor/_generated.ts. 1657 tests pass.
